body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 Force damage and move the target 1 unit directly away from you. If the target is Displaced, move it 1 additional unit.

surges.html: Choose one creature directly behind the target and within 2 units of it. Compare this Action against that creature; on a success, deal 1 Force damage.

rider.title: SPACE THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to increase or decrease its range by 2 units.
